scope: OmniRoute gateway features on the selected runtime jobs; client context tooling stays in the separate token lane

required_bindings: native pipeline settings hash without secrets

candidate_conditions.status: conditional research arm; cannot become default from mechanical fidelity alone
separate arm pending supported isolation contract
separate arm pending source and route identity

evaluator.stock_omniroute_eval_limit: Released eval:compression and compare/verify do not expose the required effort contract; their screening results cannot qualify native Ultra or complete provider usage.

tasks.source: Exact tasks, snapshots, extensions and graders inherited from frozen coding/gatherer/role protocols; no new task chosen after seeing compression results
tasks.order: paired AB/BA with one feature changed at a time

decision_rule.quality: Every paired task retains its frozen useful-task quality outcome and required exact/protected material. Any regression or unqualified route rejects the feature as a default.
decision_rule.efficiency: Require at least5 percent lower paired median native input+output tokens and no increase in paired median agent time. Require complete native counters before a consumption claim; cache/reasoning fields remain subsets.
decision_rule.lossy: A stock fidelity gate or estimated token reduction alone never passes the useful-task gate

counter_scopes: Native input and output, including failures, once per non-overlapping attempt
Gateway preprocessing estimates and estimator provenance
Gateway request aggregate versus overlapping engine breakdown
Cost only when returned by the provider; otherwise unknown
failure_rules: Preserve no-op, zero savings, opt-in misses, request-shape skips, validation fallbacks, failures, interruptions and unknown usage
Suspend on429 or another lane entering the window
Do not claim null encrypted-reasoning effort columns prove no effort
Do not extract gateway credentials for an evaluator
Do not count historical September30 bodies as a new runtime execution
required_before_freeze: Installed gateway source/carry and native request transform
Exact feature plans and settings hashes
Native snapshot and restoration contract for any shared gateway mutation
